ℹ️  Schedule FA Table A2 (the foreign custodial account itself) was NOT generated because [account.custodian] is not configured in user.toml. ITR-2 requires disclosing the IBKR account in Table A2 (foreign custodial account) IN ADDITION TO the holdings inside it in Table A3 (written above) — Table A3 on its own is an incomplete Schedule FA disclosure. The custodian's name / address / country are not carried in the IBKR statement, so they must be supplied: add an [account.custodian] block to user.toml (run `ibkr-fa init` for an annotated template) and re-run to emit Table A2.
